cards.text: Elijah, the LORD's prophet, has just faced down the prophets of Baal, a false god, on Mount Carmel (1 Kings 18:20-40). Now Ahab, king of Israel, goes and tells his wife Jezebel (1 Kings 16:31) everything Elijah did, including how he killed all the prophets with the sword. Friend, you can feel this one coming.

cards.question: Jezebel hears it all. What does she do about Elijah?

answers.text: Sends him a messenger with a threat
Sends him a gift to make peace

cards.text: Her message: she swears by her gods that by this time tomorrow, she'll make his life like the lives of those he killed.

cards.question: When Jezebel's message comes, Elijah runs for his life. True or false?

cards.text: Elijah is afraid, and one message has him GONE. Faster than I hop away from a hot oven, and friend, I hop with a whole gold base attached.
He runs all the way to Beersheba, down in Judah, and there he leaves his servant behind.

cards.question: Elijah leaves his servant in Beersheba. Where does Elijah himself go next?

answers.text: A day's journey into the wilderness

cards.text: There he sits down under a broom tree, all alone. I think he's running on empty.

cards.question: Alone under the broom tree, what does Elijah pray for?

answers.text: That the rain would keep falling

cards.text: Elijah says, "I have had enough, LORD," and then, "Take my life, for I am no better than my fathers." Then he lies down under the broom tree and falls asleep.

cards.question: While Elijah sleeps under the broom tree, the servant he left in Beersheba finds him and wakes him up. True or false?

cards.text: An angel touches him and says, "Get up and eat." I bet Elijah's lying there thinking, eat WHAT, out here in the WILDERNESS?

cards.question: Right there by his head, Elijah finds a cake of ___ baked over hot coals, and a jar of water.

cards.text: Bread by his head and a jar of water, friend, that's ROOM SERVICE. Elijah eats, drinks and lies right back down.

cards.question: After Elijah lies back down, the angel of the LORD comes back and touches him a second time. True or false?
The angel of the LORD tells Elijah to get up and eat again. What reason does the angel give?

answers.text: The journey will be too much for him
Jezebel's messenger is about to find him
His servant is coming to take him home

cards.text: He hit snooze once, and friend, his alarm came BACK. So Elijah gets up, eats and drinks, and strengthened by that food, he walks forty days and forty nights.

cards.question: Elijah's long walk ends at ___, the mountain of God, where God once called to Moses, Israel's leader, from a burning bush (Exodus 3:1-4).

cards.text: At Horeb, Elijah enters a cave and spends the night. Then the word of the LORD comes to him: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
Elijah says he has been very zealous for the LORD, the God of Hosts. But the Israelites have forsaken the LORD's covenant, torn down His altars and killed His prophets with the sword.

cards.question: In the cave, Elijah tells the LORD the Israelites have killed His prophets. What does Elijah say about himself?

answers.text: He is the only one left
He will go back and fight

cards.text: Elijah says, "I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well." Then the LORD says, "Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD. Behold, the LORD is about to pass by."
A great and mighty wind tears into the mountains and shatters the rocks before the LORD. Rocks SHATTERING, and friend, I'd be hiding behind my own mustache.

cards.question: The LORD was not in the great and mighty wind. True or false?

cards.text: After the wind comes an earthquake, but the LORD was not in the earthquake. Then comes a fire.

cards.question: The LORD was in the fire. True or false?
Wind, earthquake and fire have all come, and the LORD was in none of them. What comes after the fire?
When Elijah hears the still small voice, what does he do?

answers.text: Wraps his face in his cloak and steps out
Runs deeper into the back of the cave
Falls facedown and stays inside the cave

cards.text: At the mouth of the cave, a voice asks him the same question as before: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

cards.question: At the mouth of the cave, how does Elijah answer the voice's question this time?

answers.text: He says the same thing he said the first time
He says he is ready to go back to Israel
He says he is sorry he ran from Jezebel

cards.text: The LORD tells Elijah to go back the way he came, to the Desert of Damascus, and anoint Hazael as king over Aram and Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel. Forty days to get here, friend, and step one is TURN AROUND.

cards.question: The LORD also tells Elijah to anoint Elisha son of Shaphat, from Abel-meholah. What will Elisha be?

cards.text: Jehu will put to death whoever escapes Hazael's sword, and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes Jehu's. Then the LORD adds one more thing.

cards.question: The LORD tells Elijah that he really is the only one left in Israel who hasn't bowed to Baal. True or false?

cards.text: The LORD has reserved SEVEN THOUSAND in Israel whose knees have not bowed to Baal, and Elijah said he was the only one left! So Elijah leaves and finds Elisha plowing with twelve teams of oxen, and Elisha is with the twelfth team.

cards.question: Elijah passes by Elisha in the field and throws his ___ around him.

cards.text: Elisha leaves the oxen and RUNS after Elijah. One cloak, and the man is OUT of that field.

cards.question: Elisha asks Elijah for one thing before he follows him. What is it?

answers.text: To kiss his father and mother goodbye
To finish plowing the whole field first
To bring his brothers along with him

cards.text: Elijah tells him, "Go on back," and asks what he has done to Elisha. So Elisha turns back from him and takes his pair of oxen.

cards.question: Elisha takes his pair of oxen. What does he do with them?

answers.text: Slaughters them and feeds the people
Gives them to his father to keep
Sells them to pay for the journey

cards.text: He uses the oxen's equipment for fuel, cooks the meat and gives it to the people, and they eat. Friend, he didn't just quit his job, he BURNED it.

cards.question: After the people eat, Elisha sets out to follow and serve Elijah. True or false?
